description: This Java source file defines the ContactsListFragment class, which is a UI component in an Android app that displays a list of contacts fetched from the Contacts Provider. It supports searching, displays contact photos and names, handles item selection, and manages asynchronous image loading. It includes inner classes for the contacts adapter and interface callbacks for interaction with hosting activities. The file implements cursor loaders to query contacts, handles configuration changes, and provides search integration via the ActionBar SearchView.

classes.name: ContactsAdapter
classes.description: A CursorAdapter subclass that binds contact data to list item views, supports section indexing, and highlights search query matches.

classes.name: ContactsQuery
classes.description: An interface defining constants used for querying the contacts database, including URIs, projections, and selection strings.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, restores saved state, sets up image loader and adapter.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Binds the adapter to the list view, sets item click and scroll listeners, initializes data loader.

methods.name: onItemClick
methods.description: Handles contact list item clicks, notifies parent activity with selected contact URI.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Sets up the action bar menu, including search view configuration and listener setup.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Updates adapter cursor with query results, manages selection state in two-pane layouts.

methods.name: onLoaderReset
methods.description: Clears the adapter's cursor when the loader is reset.

methods.name: loadContactPhotoThumbnail
methods.description: Loads and scales contact thumbnail images asynchronously from contact data URI.
